note: Object data for the preview's object stage, extracted 2026-11-17 by tools/extract-constants --object-data from empires2_x2_p1.dat. Each object row: id, cls (class), type (constructor type), g (standing graphic), hp, r (terrain restriction), c (collision half-size), p (placement half-size), z (vertical extent), o (outline half-size), spd (speed), cbo (can be built on), slope (hill mode), act (pathing action), kind (obstruction class), ctr and side (placement terrains), res (first resource slot), fnd (foundation terrain), ann (annexes: id, x, y), civs (civilizations that have it, all when absent), hid (hidden in the editor). graphics: id -> [angles, flags (0x02 random angle, 0x04 random facet), frames], for graphics with more than one angle or a flag. restrictions: the multiplier per terrain, by restriction id. wallGates: the gate per wall object and run direction.
